preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner or have control of the ________ address (0x3aB960dCf9359083DC126222c03bfB0d2A3C9b6b)
Attacker must hold some MemeFarm tokens to sell

exploit_hint: As the contract owner or ________ address controller: 1) First call qwidji() to blacklist the attacker's address (set _________[attacker] = true). 2) Then sell tokens through the DEX pair. The _transfer function will check if _________[sender] is true and revert with require(false), preventing the sale. 3) Meanwhile, other users can still buy tokens, creating a honeypot where only the owner can sell. This allows the owner to drain liquidity by selling their tokens while preventing others from selling.
